description: This file contains shell functions and tests related to encoding conversions, specifically for UTF-16 and UTF-32, including prerequisites and helper functions for writing encoded data.

methods.name: write_utf16
methods.description: Writes UTF-16 encoded data to standard output, optionally with a BOM based on prerequisite check.

methods.name: write_utf32
methods.description: Writes UTF-32 encoded data to standard output, optionally with a BOM based on prerequisite check.
